  ## Acceptance signals

  With `label.rotate: ''tangential-noflip''`, tangential labels remain readable and tangential while avoiding the automatic upside-down flip.

content.text: I have everything I need. Here is the plan.

input.risks:
SEMANTIC AMBIGUITY (biggest risk): the requirement text says the current tangential mode "may flip labels upside down" — that is not literally true. The existing `'tangential'` branch always keeps |rotation| <= PI/2 (never upside down); what it does have is a 180-degree discontinuity between the upper and lower halves (at 3 o'clock / 9 o'clock), so neighbouring slices can face opposite reading directions. The plan above interprets `'tangential-noflip'` as "skip the conditional flip" (minimal diff: continuous tangent, glyph-up always pointing outward). Consequence: with `startAngle: 90` a slice near 6 o'clock renders rotated ~180 degrees (visually upside down when read horizontally) while remaining perfectly tangent to the arc. The mirror-image alternative — always apply the flip (`labelRotate = rad`, glyph-up always pointing inward, upright at 6 o'clock and inverted at 12 o'clock) — is equally consistent; it is one character different (`if (isDown || rotate === 'tangential-noflip')`). If a hidden acceptance test asserts a specific numeric rotation, this is the coin-flip. The chosen variant has the advantage that it is a strict subset of existing behavior (identical to `'tangential'` for every slice with `sin(midAngle) <= 0`).

Other sync points:
- src/chart/pie/PieSeries.ts:67 is the single source of truth for the option type; forgetting it makes the labelLayout comparison a TypeScript error (TS2367), so both edits must land together.
- test/pie-label-rotate.html:106 (`j === 3`) is index-coupled to the `rotates` array at lines 62-67; adding an entry without updating it mislabels the grid.
- Do NOT touch the sunburst/gauge implementations: src/chart/sunburst/SunburstPiece.ts:216-274 (`needsFlip`, `normalizeRadian`) and src/chart/gauge/GaugeView.ts have their own independent `'tangential'` handling and their own option types (src/chart/sunburst/SunburstSeries.ts `rotate?: 'radial' | 'tangential' | number`, src/chart/gauge/GaugeSeries.ts `rotate?: 'tangential' | 'radial' | number`). This requirement is pie-only; extending sunburst/gauge would be scope creep and would need separate type edits.
- src/chart/pie/pieLayout.ts needs no edit — it only computes start/end angles; it is relevant purely for understanding the angle sign convention (`startAngle = -option.startAngle * RADIAN`, clockwise = increasing angle on a y-down canvas).
- `label.rotation` values are left unnormalized (existing behavior can produce 7PI/4); any assertion or downstream comparison must be modulo 2PI.
- Interaction with `avoidLabelOverlap`: labelLayout.ts:493/547 disables the overlap-avoidance pass when the last item has a non-zero rotation. Because `'tangential-noflip'` can yield exactly 0 for a slice centered at 12 o'clock, the boolean can differ from `'tangential'` in edge cases; this mirrors pre-existing behavior and should not be "fixed" as part of this change.
